about:
LiMake operates from Shenzhen, China, positioning itself within the Greater Bay Area's extensive manufacturing supply chain. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The company provides a broad suite of manufacturing services centered on prototype development, engineering builds, and low-volume production. Core processes include CNC machining (milling, turning, drilling), 3D printing across SLA, SLS, MJF, and metal powder bed fusion, vacuum casting, injection molding, sheet metal fabrication (cutting and bending), and die casting in aluminum and zinc alloys. Beyond part production, LiMake offers 3D scanning and reverse engineering, product discovery, industrial and electronic design, PCB fabrication, design-for-manufacturing guidance, and short-run manufacturing support. Project management, quality assurance, and logistics coordination are integrated into the workflow.

LiMake serves clients ranging from startups to established enterprises that require rapid prototyping, bridge tooling, and short-run production. While the website does not enumerate specific industry verticals, the service mix suggests relevance to electronics, consumer products, aerospace components, and general industrial equipment development.

The company emphasizes its digital service platform as a differentiator, stating that it helps clients manage projects efficiently and transparently through digital processes. It also highlights its integrated supply chain network in the Greater Bay Area, combining engineering, quality control, and logistics under one roof to provide a clear path from design to production.

name: Iowa Steel Masters
old_description: Iowa Steel Masters is a family-owned custom roll-forming company located in the heart of Iowa. We believe in providing our clients with high-quality steel panels, custom trim, and accessories.
about:
Iowa Steel Masters operates from Ackley, Iowa, as a family-owned custom roll-forming business. The company was established to supply steel panels, custom trim, and accessories to customers across the Midwest, though a founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in roll-forming steel roofing and siding panels, along with custom trim profiles for agricultural, residential, and commercial buildings. Its product line includes ventilators and double-6 soffits that can be cut to lengths ranging from one inch to over 20 feet. Production facilities run on 100 percent solar energy, and the company emphasizes direct delivery to job sites or customer yards.

Primary markets include agricultural operations needing durable building envelopes, residential contractors seeking metal roofing, and commercial projects requiring low-maintenance cladding. The team works with contractors and end-users alike, shipping from its central Iowa location to keep transit times short.

Iowa Steel Masters highlights its solar-powered manufacturing and the ability to offer same-day delivery on certain orders as key differentiators. The ownership stresses sustainable practices and a partnership approach that aims to make its customers look good to their own clients.

name: Ira Middleswarth & Son, Inc.
old_description: Middleswarth Thin Pretzels – Individual Snack Bags – 96 Count
about:
Ira Middleswarth & Son, Inc. was founded in 1942 by Bob Middleswarth in Beavertown, Pennsylvania. The business incorporated in 1959 after moving to Orange Street in Beavertown, and in 1961 a new 40,000-square-foot plant was built in Middleburg, where the company remains headquartered.

The company manufactures kettle-cooked potato chips, thin pretzels, cheese puff curls, and assorted gift baskets. Current production runs at roughly 3,400 pounds of chips per hour with a workforce averaging 90 employees. The Middleburg facility includes fryers and packing lines added during a 1974 expansion.

Middleswarth serves the snack-food market through a network of eleven Pennsylvania distributors covering Sunbury, Lewistown, Altoona, Harrisburg, Wilkes-Barre, Reading, State College, Lehigh Valley, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, and Sayre. The company also sells directly to consumers worldwide via its e-commerce site.

The business emphasizes its family-owned heritage—Dave Middleswarth succeeded his father Bob as president in 2007—and promotes the distinctive taste and quality that originated from its original kettle process.

name: Iron Mountain Forge & Furniture
old_description: The shop, now located in the historic Atlantic Mills in Providence, RI, specializes in metal fabrication and design, and has the ability to take on projects–large or small!
about:
Iron Mountain Forge & Furniture began in 2013 as a one-woman operation in Boone, North Carolina, founded by Carley Ferrara. Ferrara, who holds a BFA in Interior Design from Miami University of Ohio and an MFA in Furniture Design from the Rhode Island School of Design, moved the shop to the historic Atlantic Mills building in Providence, Rhode Island, where it now operates as a woman-owned studio with a team of seven craftspeople plus interns.

The studio specializes in metal fabrication, blacksmithing, welding, and woodworking to produce custom furniture and decorative pieces. Projects range from small forged items to large-scale installations, all designed and built in-house. The team also runs hands-on forging workshops, including the popular “Sip & Smash” class, and sells a line of ready-made goods through an Etsy shop.

Clients include individual homeowners, interior designers, and commercial customers across the United States and internationally, with the company noting it ships custom pieces worldwide. The Etsy channel serves retail buyers looking for gifts and smaller accessories, while the workshop classes attract hobbyists and groups seeking a guided metalworking experience.

Ferrara’s guiding principle is that furniture should be built to last generations, not years, a philosophy reflected in the studio’s emphasis on handcrafted detail and durable construction. Her background—including a 2015 appearance on HGTV’s Ellen’s Design Challenge—underscores a commitment to design integrity that the company cites as its primary differentiator.

name: Iron&Oak Metal Fabrication
old_description: Bringing Your Vision into Reality: Custom Steel, Crafted with Precision.
about:
Iron & Oak Metal Fabrication operates from New Fairfield, Connecticut. The company was founded by David DiCairano, who began his career as an ornamental ironworker in the New York City metropolitan area in 2003. After years of union experience working on custom railings, gates, decorative pieces, and large-scale stairs, DiCairano established Iron & Oak to bring that same level of craftsmanship to homeowners and small businesses. The business remains family-run, with DiCairano citing his wife Stacey and their two children as the inspiration behind the venture.

The shop specializes in custom steel fabrication, producing one-of-a-kind pieces ranging from residential and commercial railings to custom table bases, home decor items, and ornamental gates and staircases. Work is performed on a project-by-project basis, with each piece fabricated, welded, and finished in-house. No facility size or employee count is disclosed, but the operation focuses on low-volume, high-mix custom work rather than mass production.

Primary customers include homeowners seeking unique metal fixtures, small businesses needing custom railings or decorative elements, and designers or architects specifying one-off metalwork. Past projects have included residential stair railings, commercial entry gates, and bespoke furniture bases.

DiCairano emphasizes that his union background instilled a commitment to craftsmanship and a high-quality finish on every project. The company positions itself on attention to detail and the ability to translate a client’s vision into a finished metal piece, rather than on speed or volume.

about:
Ironwood Electronics was founded in 1986 in Eagan, Minnesota, a suburb of Minneapolis. The company began as a source for advanced adapters, sockets, and modules for electronic component testing.

Today, Ironwood designs and manufactures adapters that convert package and pitch between devices, modules that provide fully tested assemblies for component replacement and upgrade, and sockets used for component and assembly testing from silicon characterization and validation through burn-in and high-volume automated testing. Operations run from a 25,000-square-foot facility with over 70 employees, housing engineering and manufacturing under one roof. The catalog includes more than 10,000 standard part numbers, supplemented by custom solutions developed for specific applications.

The company serves customers in electronics and semiconductor testing who require solutions for new silicon characterization, validation, burn-in, and high-volume automated test environments. Its products are used in applications ranging from prototype validation to production-scale testing.

Ironwood emphasizes high performance and minimal footprint in its designs, a focus reinforced by continuous new product development and the recent acquisition of the Grypper socket line. The company states that it has encountered very few testing challenges it cannot address.

name: Island Pacific Energy
old_description: For over 19 years, Island Pacific Energy has been Hawaii's most trusted solar company, dedicated to helping homeowners and businesses achieve energy independence.
about:
Island Pacific Energy is based in Honolulu, Hawaii, and has been serving the islands since 2007. The company was founded to provide sustainable energy solutions to homeowners and businesses across Hawaii.

The firm specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of solar energy systems, offering turnkey services that cover permitting, approvals, and final commissioning. It has completed over 10 megawatts of clean energy installations across the Hawaiian islands and has been named a National Top Solar Contractor for 12 consecutive years. The company reports a 100% customer satisfaction rate on its projects.

Its customers include residential homeowners seeking energy independence, commercial clients such as Punahou School looking to convert energy liabilities into fixed assets, and community-scale projects. The company designs scalable microgrids for businesses and provides battery storage integration for both residential and commercial applications.

Island Pacific Energy differentiates itself through zero-down financing options, an educational sales approach, and a commitment to using only tier-1 equipment from top manufacturers. Its mission is to make clean, affordable energy accessible to everyone in Hawaii, a goal recognized by awards including the Governor's Award for Innovation and multiple Business Leadership Hawaii honors.

name: J & J Sheet Metal
old_description: Custom Fabrication Work With Galvanized, Stainless, Aluminum, and PCD
about:
J & J Sheet Metal operates from Clinton Township, Michigan, where it was founded in 1944. The company is a fourth‑generation family‑owned business that has remained in the same family since its inception, though the founders’ names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom sheet metal fabrication and the wholesale supply of HVAC pipe fittings and accessories. Its capabilities include spiral pipe manufacturing, coil‑line duct fabrication, automated cleat forming, and plasma cutting, working with galvanized steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and PCD. Equipment listed by the company comprises a plasma table, coil line, spiral machine, and cleat line. The company notes it keeps thousands of parts in stock for immediate shipment.

J & J serves the residential and commercial HVAC markets, providing rectangular and round duct fittings, oval accessories, and spiral pipe for ductwork and supply systems. Customers include HVAC contractors and mechanical installers who rely on the company’s job‑site delivery service to receive fabricated components on schedule.

The business emphasizes its four‑generation legacy as a differentiator, citing fast lead times and a hands‑on approach to customer service that treats each project as if it were their own.

name: J Leftwich Custom Furniture, LLC
old_description: Custom built for your lifestyle, with form and function to add a sense of serenity to your living space.
about:
Based in Erie, Colorado, J Leftwich Custom Furniture, LLC produces custom-built furniture for residential and commercial clients. The company operates as a small workshop focused on handcrafted pieces tailored to individual lifestyles.

The shop handles the full project lifecycle, beginning with design consultation and 3D modeling to visualize pieces, followed by material selection that includes sustainably sourced and reclaimed woods. Construction covers a range of items such as dining tables, coffee tables, desks, storage solutions, beds, cabinetry, and built-in libraries. Finishing uses environmentally conscious coatings, and the team manages delivery and installation. A repair consultation service evaluates existing furniture for restoration versus replacement.

Clients include homeowners seeking unique furnishings for living spaces and professionals outfitting offices or other work environments. Projects are scoped to each client’s budget and functional requirements, with an emphasis on pieces that integrate into specific rooms.

The company distinguishes itself through an end-to-end experience that blends collaborative design with sustainable woodworking practices. By incorporating reclaimed materials from urban logging or storm damage, the workshop aims to create heirloom-quality furniture that adds long-term value to a home.
